# Source: Vase

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Vase
- **Artist / culture:** Fritz Heckert Glass Refinery and Glassworks Petersdorf, Silesia (now Poland), 1866-1923 Possibly designed by Otto Thamm German, 1860-c. 1905 Possibly decorated by Adolph Heyden German, 1838-1902
- **Date:** c. 1900
- **Style:** Art Deco
- **Classification:** vase
- **Department:** Applied Arts of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 216318
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/216318
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/ebe50463-49dc-187e-6072-296c2432b571/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Art Deco

## Extracted source palette

`#C8C8C8, #A8A8A8, #686878, #988888, #D8B868, #484868, #B8A888, #88A888`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#36363E`
- `surface`: `#4D4D54`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#D8B868`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#484868`
- `surface_variant`: `#4D4D54`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#6C6C72`
- `error`: `#D8B868`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `20dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `11.26:1`, surface `7.88:1`
- Variant contrast: `7.88:1`
- Control contrast: `10.21:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
